description.en: The application ID. You can create and query it in the console.

title.zh: 获取自动旁路单路转推规则
title.en: Query an automatic live stream relay rule

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateAutoLiveStreamRule](~~353179~~)创建旁路规则。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
Before you call this operation, you must have called the [CreateAutoLiveStreamRule](~~353179~~) operation to create a relay rule.
# QPS limits
The per-user QPS limit on this operation is 1,000 calls per minute. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call the operation appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
